title: Relationship before notation
language: Deviation, distribution and flow choose different visual forms
summary: Choose notation from the analytical relationship while preserving grain and units.
use_when: Analytical explanation, chart selection and reviewing what an encoding implies.
avoid_when: Treating a familiar chart silhouette as an answer before the question and data grain.
